desc:
Hide from Giant is a hide and seek game where the seeker transforms into a GIANT who can crush anything in their path!

How to play:
🫣 HIDERS: Find the best hiding spots, sneak around the map, and use your abilities to survive until the timer ends. Don’t get caught!
😡 GIANT: Smash your way through the map! Punch, stomp, and destroy everything to hunt down every last Hider!

💪☄️Obtain Powerful Abilities & Useful Skills by collecting Coins!

Tags: Hide and Seek, Hide N Seek, Hide & Seek ,Disguise, Sneak, Stealth, Giant
